bead.title: Add side-record and instance-fence tables to the in-scope postgres backend(s)
bead.description:
PROBLEM
WriteSideRecords and AdvanceInstanceFence commands are rejected with EngineError::Unavailable on postgres (crates/pqueue-postgres/src/relational.rs, comments at the WriteSideRecords/AdvanceInstanceFence match arms) because no storage exists for them.

PROPOSED FIX
Add the postgres tables/schema for opaque non-work side records and per-instance-key fences, for the backend flavor(s) settled in pqueue-ab2e0b21, mirroring sqlite-relational's schema and migration approach. Wire schema creation into the same migration path sqlite-relational uses (see the existing `open_upgrades_existing_relational_items_table_with_metadata_column`-style reconnect test for the pattern this project expects).

IN-SCOPE FILES
- crates/pqueue-postgres/src/relational.rs (and/or lib.rs per pqueue-ab2e0b21's scope decision)

OUT-OF-SCOPE
- The commit_transition orchestration method itself (next bead).
- RecoveryReadPort (separate bead).
bead.acceptance:
1. `rg -n 'CREATE TABLE.*side_record|CREATE TABLE.*instance_fence' crates/pqueue-postgres/src/relational.rs` finds the new schema.
2. A live-DB test (env-gated PQUEUE_PG_TEST_URL, matching the existing convention in crates/pqueue-postgres/tests/) proves WriteSideRecords/AdvanceInstanceFence commands persist and survive reconnect.
3. `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass.
